facts: tank1 only drains through its bottom port, so its exact temperature is the constant 323.15 K; the 11 non-high of 85 channels are aliases of tank1 temperature (K and degC), specific enthalpy and internal energy
OMC (dassl, rtol 1e-6) spreads 6.4e-6 K and 0.027 J/kg on the specific enthalpy (2.092e5 J/kg): 1.3e-7 relative, 0.13 x rtol
Rumoca (bdf, rtol 1e-6, atol 1e-10) has mean error 5.0e-5 K and 0.21 J/kg on the specific enthalpy: 1.0e-6 relative, 1.0 x rtol, 7.9 x OMC
at rtol = atol = 1e-10 Rumoca's drift falls to 3.6e-9 K, so the gap is integration error, not a model defect
